backend/main.mo: Motoko canister handling user profiles and template CRUD with access control for user and admin roles.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to related frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing roles of various frontend modules including storage, hooks, entitlements, remote config, and template logic.
frontend/ARCHITECTURE.md: High‑level overview of the frontend architecture, tech stack, and structural principles for the mobile‑first app.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining OKLCH theme variables for light and dark modes and global UI tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point configuring mobile‑PWA meta tags and loading the React app root.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app setup defining all routes, global layout, theme provider, and system banners like offline and updates.
frontend/src/components/common/BottomTab: Bottom navigation bar component with five primary tabs and active state styling.
frontend/src/components/common/MajorUpda: Dialog that detects major remote‑config updates and prompts the user to refresh.
frontend/src/components/common/OfflineBa: Top‑screen banner that appears when offline using the offline status hook.
Small gradient badge indicating Pro‑tier content or features.
frontend/src/components/common/UpsellPro: Modal prompting users to upgrade to Pro when attempting restricted features.
frontend/src/entitlements/entitlements.t: Provides feature gating helpers based on user profile and remote config, including pro checks.
frontend/src/entitlements/useEntitlement: React hook exposing feature access checks, pro status, and monetization enablement.
frontend/src/features/auth/UserProfileGa: UI gate prompting authenticated users without a profile to create one with a name and free entitlement.
frontend/src/features/projects/projectIn: Generates new video/photo project IDs and metadata, saving them to storage for templates or blank projects.
frontend/src/features/projects/useProjec: React-query hooks for listing, searching, deleting, and duplicating stored projects.
frontend/src/features/templates/template: Merges backend and preloaded templates and provides cached template retrieval.
frontend/src/features/templates/useTempl: React-query hooks for merged template lists and checking template cache status.
frontend/src/features/theme/ThemeProvide: Manages app theme state, syncing with system preference and exposing a theme context.
Dropdown UI allowing users to switch between light, dark, or system theme.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context, handling login, stored identity loading, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useOfflineStatus.ts: Tracks online/offline browser status via window events.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React-query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles and templates through the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS base with light/dark theme variables and layout defaults.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entrypoint setting up React Query, identity provider, styles, and rendering the root component.
frontend/src/photo-editor/PhotoEditorScr: UI for the photo editor with basic tools, adjustments, and an export dialog.
frontend/src/remote-config/remoteConfigC: Loads, caches, and fetches remote config data using localStorage.
frontend/src/remote-config/types.ts: Defines the RemoteConfig interface and provides the default configuration.
frontend/src/remote-config/useRemoteConf: React hook to load remote config, detect major version updates, and expose config state.
frontend/src/screens/CreateScreen.tsx: Screen for creating new video or photo projects and accessing templates.
frontend/src/screens/HomeScreen.tsx: Home landing screen offering quick access to create projects and browse templates.
frontend/src/screens/ProfileScreen.tsx: Profile screen showing user info, theme settings, and subscription status with login support.
frontend/src/screens/ProjectsScreen.tsx: Project list screen with search, open, delete, and duplicate actions for video and photo projects.
frontend/src/screens/TemplatesScreen.tsx: Renders a templates screen that lists video and photo templates, handles entitlement checks, and instantiates projects from selected templates.
frontend/src/storage/indexedDb.ts: Initializes and manages an IndexedDB database with CRUD helpers for projects, templates, and media.
frontend/src/storage/models.ts: Defines TypeScript models for project metadata, video/photo project states, overlays, and cached templates.
frontend/src/storage/projectsStore.ts: Provides CRUD, duplication, and search utilities for project metadata stored in IndexedDB.
frontend/src/storage/templatesCache.ts: Manages cached templates in IndexedDB, including retrieval, storage, and cache checks.
Exports a static list of predefined video and photo templates with metadata and entitlements.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/src/video-editor/VideoEditorScr: Implements a video editor UI with playback controls, tools gated by entitlements, and an export dialog with progress.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: TailwindCSS configuration extending colors, typography, animations, and container settings for the frontend.
project_state.json: Defines project metadata for ClipForge Mobile, including architecture notes for a cross‑platform offline‑first editing app, required images, and a list of existing implemented features.
